s05033.summary: On a 3 a.m. night bus, passengers drift while Russ and Nina sit apart.
Russ quietly demands the item Nina's brother took; Nina refuses, steady.
Desmond, an undercover cop, makes himself known as Nina says the drive stays with her.
Desmond shows his badge and orders Russ to sit; Russ reaches into the bag.
The bus lurches, a gun spills out, and Desmond draws as Russ trembles over it.
The lights die and nobody moves while the dog keeps barking.

s05035_0.summary: Disguised in a protest crowd, Mira lays out a forty-second heist plan; Tobias jokes about it.
Juno reports the guards changed shift early, forcing Mira to move the plan up.
Rafa warns that federal agents in the crowd are there for them, and the dock warns them off.
Mira calls off the heist and sends the four melting into the march as rain begins.

s05035_1.summary: The plaza empties; a broken cardboard sun lies face down in a puddle.

s05037.summary: Kim needles Kip, who stands in the cabin doorway in his coat, refusing to sit.
The radio phone rings; Kip answers and learns Mr. Brandt demands the job done tonight.
Kip hangs up, sets the duffel between them and unzips and rezips it; Kim asks for tea.

s05038.summary: Dennis and Phillipa, the only two at the meeting, trade dry jokes.
Phillipa admits the surgeon's fear and her craving for a drink; Dennis reassures her.
The hospital calls; Dennis lends his cardigan and sends her off with a promise to return.

s05039_0.summary: A taco truck sits near the old market with a small line in the sun.

s05039_1.summary: Jen, Mo and Big Dave work the truck while Sam quietly watches the street.
Sam notes a grey car across the road two days running; Mo suggests ignoring it.

s05039_1.actor: THE MAN IN THE BROWN COAT
s05039_1.summary: A man in a brown coat approaches the window and greets Sam as Inspector.
Sam folds his apron and walks off with the inspector while the crew carries on.

s05040_0.summary: Desmond visits his sleepless cousin Priya as she guards a locked laptop folder.
Desmond asks about her Harrow Lane text; she deflects, then reveals her evidence.
Priya shows a spreadsheet of deliveries to one house and the missing girl's key.
Desmond demands the key and Priya, standing on the bed, demands explanation first.

s05040_1.summary: Desmond insists the girl called him for a ride and he arrived too late.
Priya reads the girl's note on the photo and believes him.
Priya opens the locked folder with the key, and together they press play on the video.

s05041.summary: A documentary crew films Halvorsen and Maya at a freight depot, joking about manifests.
Maya's mum warns the news named her port and an unmarked truck is at the gate.
Korvac demands phones in a bin and the camera off; the camera drops on a pried crate.

s05042.summary: Mo drives a woman carrying an organ cooler to the hospital as the timer runs.
Dr. Nair urgently calls; Jen admits their courier crashed and the clock is running.
Mo runs a red light and floors it as high beams close in behind them.

s05043_0.summary: At a church basement meeting, Kim rants about sober cake and catches Kip texting his ex.
Tomasz tears up, donuts circulate, and Kip and Kim call a truce.

s05043_1.summary: The chairs are stacked and the banner finally falls.

s05044.summary: Passengers in Tobias's rideshare notice the clock stuck at 2:07 and repeating trees.
The hooded woman's glowing box, failing brakes and upward silver rain panic everyone.
Mara unhooded accuses Hollis of stealing her mother's key; he is forty-one, not young.
Hollis surrenders the key; the car stops and he vanishes, leaving his suit folded.
Mara tells Tobias Hollis went home and walks off as the clock reaches 2:08.

s05045.summary: At Coach Dunleavy's funeral, old teammates Ray and Luis see each other across the hall.
Luis accuses Ray of throwing the game that Frank took to his grave.
After a dropped plate silences the room, Ray apologizes and stands in the projector beam facing Frank.

s05046_0.summary: A nervous new night nurse fumbles through her first hours at the station.
Mr. Kessler kindly tells Priya she has kind hands, easing her nerves.
The intercom reveals her mom called about her forgotten lunch; she vows to quit, Kessler doubts it.

s05046_1.summary: Priya sits back down and for once does not check her phone.

s05047.summary: In a candlelit power cut, Rosalind avoids Tom's gaze while his father texts him.
Tom reveals his Durham offer; Rosalind's brittle congratulations show her pain.
Tom refuses to leave her alone, but Rosalind insists he will go and she will be fine.

s05048.summary: June, Wesley and Ben huddle under a blanket whispering ghost-story rules.
A text from Mom and a slamming door spook them; Mom asks who walked past her door.
Aunt Lin bursts from the closet in ghoul makeup, and everyone laughs and throws pillows.

s05050.summary: Hannah builds a cozy candlelit kitchen during a power cut, while Desmond studies the dark street.
Desmond summons Hannah; wrong stars above, one moving toward the house, and Beck says it is no transformer.
Hannah sees Ilya smiling at the window, saying they said it would be evening.

s05051.summary: On a strange double-decker, armed Nell tells riders they are ahead of their pursuers.
The bus coughs and dies, thumps hit the roof, and a claw punches through.
The hooded man drives off the creature with silver light and names himself Cass.

s05052.summary: Kip and Kim sit silent outside the store, bickering only through their group chat.
Jo rides up, slowly ties his horse and suggests a soda; the others stay stiff.
A message admits the weirdness; both ask Jo to stay and follow him for sodas.

s05053.summary: Sam and Mo tell a documentary crew to stop filming in the bathroom before their hearing.
Big Dave and Jen argue over the matching statement and the story that it was a door.
Mrs. K calls time and Sam sets his phone down, whispering that he will tell them.

s05055.summary: On a crowded train, Dasha texts Ivo for what he carries while Pavel watches.
Pavel closes in through the crowd, Ivo turns, and Pavel says he is in his seat.

s05057.summary: In a gaslit clinic room, Edith waits as the doctor and porter enter with a covered item.
Knocking inside the wall and a spreading dark stain frighten Pruitt and Margaret.
The knocking stops; the cloth hides only a thermometer and Hale says it is finished.

s05059.summary: Okafor questions a masked traveler whose card dates from a future year.
The traveler unmasks as Mirela, claiming she was born in the booth to Dunne's wife.
Dunne overrides Okafor and orders the barrier opened for Mirela, who thanks them.

s05061.summary: Vet Priya and Tomas banter over his old cat Biscuit, hiding tension from a cancelled dinner.
Tomas explains his mother's illness and death; Priya's armor falls.
Wendy with a puppy interrupts, reads the room, and tactfully tows the puppy out.
Tomas asks her to dinner; Priya agrees to Thursday and a Great Dane emergency calls her away.

s05063.summary: Kim and Kip crouch in a dark van hearing scraping from under the floor.
The latch turns and soaked Mo appears grinning, though Kim says Mo is up front driving.
